# journal entry postings

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:journalEntryPostings`](gmeow-journalEntryPostings.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/journalEntryPostings>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The postings that compose a journal entry. Non-functional: a journal entry has at least two postings (SHACL-enforced).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:JournalEntry`](../classes/gmeow-JournalEntry.md) -> [`gmeow:Posting`](../classes/gmeow-Posting.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:journalEntryPostings`](gmeow-journalEntryPostings.md) from [`gmeow:JournalEntry`](../classes/gmeow-JournalEntry.md) to [`gmeow:Posting`](../classes/gmeow-Posting.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
